Heading: Admin Toolkit
RoomTransferSubmitted: Host transfer request sent. Check whether the room role changes.
RoomTransferFailed: Host transfer request could not be sent or was rejected.
RoomTransferHelp: Available to a Client in an online room. Sending a request does not confirm a transfer or hand over game state.
Scope: Browse PEAK items by icon and category. Search current, English, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese names. Spawning is restricted to the room host.
AutoHelp: Auto follows PEAK's selected language. Unsupported or unavailable languages use English.
Controls: Press {0} to open or close this window. Drag the title bar to move it.
CloseHelp: Close the window and return control to the game.
NoGameplay: Gameplay tools are not available in this preview.
LanguageUnavailable: PEAK language could not be read. Auto currently uses English.
NoItems: No registered spawnable items are available.
SoloManualSpawn: Does not spawn naturally in solo
SoloManualSpawnReason: This item is excluded from solo loot. The host can manually generate it here; room item bans still apply.
ItemUnavailableReason: The game currently disallows generation, which can depend on solo play or room settings. Refresh after the game state changes.
SpawnUnavailable: Item generation needs an active room and the current game API.
SpawnRequested: Spawn request submitted; verify the result in game.
SpawnFailed: The item could not be spawned.
ShowSpecialItems: Show special / unused / lobby / multiplayer / miscellaneous items
ParachuteDescription: Auto-parachute outside the regular item catalog.
PlayerScope: Host and Client can submit revival and teleport requests for registered players. Verify remote results in game.
PlayerNoPlayers: No registered players are available in this scene.
PlayerRoomOnly: Player network actions require an active room.
PlayerNoPenaltyScope: Skips new revival curse and hunger; does not refill stamina or cleanse existing effects.
PlayerCleanseScope: Clear curable statuses, afflictions and cactus thorns on your own living character. Physical Crab, Weight and Arrow states may remain.
PlayerCleanseDone: Local cleanse applied; check status in game.
PlayerRequestSubmitted: Request submitted for {0}; check the result in game.
PlayerRequestFailed: Request unavailable or rejected; refresh player state.
SelfScope: Controls affect only your own conscious character. Each feature is independent and starts off.
GodModeHelp: Blocks new ordinary damage and negative statuses; existing conditions and healing are preserved. Scripted forced effects may bypass it.
InfiniteStaminaHelp: Prevents stamina use with the native game flag. Does not refill stamina or heal injuries.
NoFallDamageHelp: Disables fall injury and the fall-damage stumble. Other impacts still apply.
FlightFallUnavailable: Flight movement is available, but automatic fall protection is unavailable with the current game API.
FlightHelp: Fly with collisions. Stop climbing or being carried before enabling. Disabling immediately resumes gravity; fall injury stays blocked for 2 seconds.
FlightControls: WASD: horizontal movement · Space: up · Ctrl: down · Shift: 2x speed. Opening a menu or losing focus holds position. Flight blocks fall injury while active.
SelfResetHelp: Scene changes, character replacement, losing ownership, death/downing and plugin disable turn the tools off. Closing this window keeps them active.
SelfCannotEnable: Cannot enable: your character must be conscious and locally owned. Flight also requires free movement and active bodyparts.
SelfUnavailable: Unavailable with the current game API. Details are in the BepInEx log.
RecoveryScope: Host only: inspect a player's previously dropped items that are still on the ground. The list may include items dropped before death. Select only the originals you want moved; backpacks keep their contents.
RecoveryEmpty: No eligible ground items in this player's drop record.
RecoveryUnavailable: Recovery unavailable: Host authority or current item API is missing.
RecoverySubmitted: Submitted move requests for {0} items; check their positions in game.
WorldTimeHelp: Set the current time of day as Host. Day number and run timer stay unchanged.
WorldTimeChanged: Time changed locally; check other players after synchronization.
WorldTimeFailed: Could not change time; check the current game state.
WorldAdvanceHelp: The Host can warp the team to the next-area campfire, summit or Void exit portal.
WorldAdvanceSubmitted: Warp requests sent; check every player's landing and light the campfire yourselves.
WorldAdvanceFailed: Unlit campfire, safe ground or player warp unavailable. Check the BepInEx log.
WorldPeakSubmitted: Summit warp requests sent; check every player's landing.
WorldPeakLandingUnavailable: Summit landmark, safe ground or player warp unavailable. Check the BepInEx log.
WorldHostRequired: Host in an active room required.
WorldTimeApiUnavailable: Time control is unavailable in this PEAK build.
WorldMapApiUnavailable: Map control is unavailable in this PEAK build or scene.
WorldNoNextSegment: No supported next area from the summit; use the game's hidden-area entrance.
WorldEndpointSubmitted: Endpoint warp requests sent. Enter the portal yourselves.
WorldEndpointUnavailable: Active endpoint portal, safe ground or player warp unavailable. Check the BepInEx log.
